title: Bitlance Group Ltd — Corporate Digital & IT Consultancy Website
brief: An IT consultancy and technology group required a bold, high-contrast corporate website to present multi-discipline digital transformation, e-commerce, and enterprise consultancy services.
approach: Constructed an animated, technology-forward hero section with service-led information architecture, clear capability matrices, and seamless enterprise inquiry triggers.
outcome: Established enterprise credibility and positioned the firm for competitive procurement bids and corporate client partnerships.
